main_text.p: bus abjudicentur ; praeterea diffiteri non poteft Vir eruditus extare antiquissimum cujusdam Pontificis Romani Decretum, quo liber Hermae ad apocrypha ablega-tur, & hoc sufficit, quamvis de Decreti Autore non constaret.

VII.Instat secundo doctissimus vindiciarum Pearf.Autor, observátque referre quidem Gra-tianum, Decretum hoc scriptum fuisse à Gelasio in Concilio LXX. Episcoporum, sed tamen in vetustissimis MSS. illa de Concilio desiderari, quod probat autori-tate Codicis MS. qui Cantabrigiae asservatur, & qui hunc titulum praefert, De-creta Gelasij Papae de recipiendis & non recipiendis Libris, quae scripta sunt ab eo cum LXX. eruditissimis Episcopi[?] conjicit autem hunc titulum fuisse antiquissimum, tum quod apud Burchardum ita concipi-tur, tum quod maximè, inquit, illis con-venit quae apud Lupum Ferrariensem Epist. 128. legimus. Quoniam docet Gela-sius cum LXX. Episcopis viris eruditissimis, qui scriptores essent vel non essent recipiendi. page.notes: The first word "bus" continues a word hyphenated at the end of the previous page ("ob-"). The word "Episcopi[?]" is partly covered by a dark ink blot; the final letter is uncertain (probably "s", as in "cum LXX. Episcopis" later on the page). The marginal notes "VII.", "Pearf." and "p.45." are placed beside the lines where they stand; "p.45." may be read as "p.45." with the numeral partly faint. A "Digitized by Google" watermark at the lower right was omitted. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, and u/v was normalised in accordance with the rules.
